name: Bug report (English)
about: Report a reproducible problem with charts, AI, indicators or local data.

## Environment

App version or source commit:
Operating system and processor:
Provider, symbol and timeframe (when relevant):

## Reproduce

Describe the steps, expected behavior and actual behavior. For AI actions, include the tool's visible result, not only the assistant's wording. Say whether the input is synthetic or real, and whether the problem also occurs without the custom extension.

## Safe diagnostics

Attach a sanitized screenshot, error or minimal example. Do not post API keys, MCP tokens/configuration, account credentials, personal paths or private datasets. Do not disable security protections just to submit a reproduction.
